finding.source_terminal_band: The October 6 family-376 clocks.tex and September 27 companion specify Psi_i(x,y)=(a_*+lambda*x,b_i+lambda*y), terminal b_H=1/16, lambda=1/[100(m+N+1)]. Since m,N are finite nonnegative counts and a tape radix code y lies in [0,1], every source terminal encoded point has 1/16 <= Y <= 1/16+lambda <= 29/400. The actual m,N are positive, so the last inequality is strict.
finding.lean_preconjugacy: Pinned RecorderObservation.codedPoint_first and FiniteLabels.stateOffset give preconjugacy first coordinate u_0=(3/4 if halting else 1/4)+kappa*(x-1/2), with 0<=x<=1 and 0<kappa=bandScale<=1/64.
finding.lean_conjugacy: Pinned PlanarRecorder.coordinateMap is PlanarConjugacy.map(shift,43/128,compression,11/32). Its physical vertical coordinate is Y=43/128-(11/32)*u_0, regardless of horizontal compression. The terminal center is 5/64 and the nonterminal center is 1/4. This coordinate rotation/reflection with positive determinant is not the source's literal scalar Psi_i embedding.
finding.lean_translation: Pinned PlanarInitialShift.initialShift_spec sends the initialized recorder point to (1/4,1/4). For freshInput, fresh_initial_nonhalting plus initialShift_small gives |delta_Y|<=3/1024. PlanarProcessorData.normalizedInstruction applies exactly this translation to the program, so the normalized encoded points use the same delta.
finding.sharp_uniform_bounds: For every Lean valid input and any terminal recorder configuration of its fresh machine, the normalized physical Y is in [297/4096,343/4096]. For any nonterminal recorder configuration it is in [1001/4096,1047/4096]. These follow from the codedPoint_first identity, |x-1/2|<=1/2, kappa<=1/64, and |delta_Y|<=3/1024. The total deviation is at most 11/4096+12/4096=23/4096.
finding.disjoint_terminal_bands: The source terminal upper bound 29/400 is strictly below the normalized Lean terminal lower bound 297/4096; their difference is exactly 1/102400. Hence the two terminal encoded-point vertical bands are disjoint under literal physical-coordinate identification, even after Lean's input-dependent initial shift. This rules out literal equality of the two terminal coordinate embeddings; it does NOT rule out a nontrivial coordinate conjugacy or identical halting observations.
finding.observer_preservation: Both source terminal Y in [1/16,29/400] and Lean normalized terminal Y in [297/4096,343/4096] lie strictly inside the same detector (1/32,1/8). Lean normalized_run_observer_iff supplies its own halting equivalence; the source companion asserts its own. Agreement of the detector event is a property-level bridge, not proof of equal complete trajectories.
finding.comparison_to_prior: Prior PR #467 mapped the three affine move formulas on refined cylinders and noted the normalized initial point, and PR #468 mapped the seven-row compiler. Neither identified the explicit normalized terminal vertical center, the uniform disjointness gap, or the source-vs-Lean terminal encoding obstruction. This record does not re-admit those earlier claims.
